GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2018-10-20T14:10:40Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Cannot retrieve symbols under a type alias
Description: Hi,

I'm used **Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.2.8.2** and they dependents.

I cannot retrieve `ISymbol` and `ITypeSymbol` (they are just nothing in the relevant `Info` structures) using `SemantciModel.GetSymbolInfo` and `SemantciModel.GetTypeInfo` for the type alias identifier (`KNFE`) in the code below:

```c#
using KNFE = System.Collections.Generic.KeyNotFoundException;
```

At first, I tried append before these using a something that will be used this alias:

```c#
/// <see cref="KNFE"/>
using KNFE = System.Collections.Generic.KeyNotFoundException;
```
and I still cannot receive symbols for `KNFE` identifier under `NameEqualsSyntax`, but can for the identifier under the `NameMemberCrefSyntax`. I checked that the boths `IdentifierNameSyntax` have the same kind.

At second, I assumed it can be due that using was determined as unused, so I added reference on it:

```c#
/// <see cref="KNFE"/>
using KNFE = System.Collections.Generic.KeyNotFoundException;

class Some
{
    KNFE field;
}
```
but I still cannot receive symbols.

As workaround I can receive symbols from the right hand of equals in the using directive
